purpose: Generated surroundings for the styled genome stamp (tome plates per clan, a Caddy paper strip, two style references); the stamp faces themselves are encoder cells styled in code, never generated. Concept art awaiting the owner's choice.

tool.name: Gemini API
tool.auth: API key from the environment; not recorded

models.gemini-3-pro-image: Gemini 3 Pro Image: final candidates and refinements

tool.modelChoice: Pro for every call: engraved plates need fine, exact line work, and the references must reproduce the real stamp face's layout and hues.
tool.output: image/jpeg 2048x2048 (1:1 at 2K), kept byte-exact in raw/ for kept candidates; LANCZOS to 1024x1024 as the canvas PNG. Composites of the real stamp into a generated plate are recorded under 'composites'.
tool.imageInputs: Sent as inline image parts, each preceded by a short text part stating its role; the preamble, then the prompt verbatim as the last text part.
tool.budget: At most 16 generations for this task; 9 used (round 1: 7, round 2: 2), all on gemini-3-pro-image. No call failed; none was retried. The stamp faces are not generated; the owner's decisions were applied in code without new generation.

references.art/miniature-lives/assets/rich-plain-30: clan reference only for the C01 plate's leaf motif; the creature is not drawn
references.art/concept-stamp/renders/*.png: the real styled stamp faces, attached to the two style references as the thing to illustrate

directions.T tome-plate-c01: A herbarium plate with an engraved trefoil-leaf border in moss ink and an empty centre square for the stamp (the hopper frame's clan, C01).
directions.F tome-plate-c03: A herbarium plate with an engraved lantern motif in umber ink and an empty centre square (the glowtail frame's clan, C03); round 1 as a border, round 2 at the corners only.
directions.C caddy-strip: A photograph of blank 58 mm thermal paper on a table, for the Caddy label composite.
directions.R style-ref: Illustrations of the real stamp face on the tome page and on the lab's glass plate: references for the eye, never decoded.

plan.rounds: One round of seven; a second only if a plate's centre is not clean enough to carry the stamp.
plan.ownerDecisions: 2026-10-07: round perforations in every clan; the border cells alone carry the clan; copy hues lagoon and brick; no glint or amber on the stamp; flair, not ornament, reproducible in print; clans keyed by taxonomy codes C01 to C16.
